fact: INSTAT Gabon has begun preparing the third national statistics development strategy (SNDS-III, 2027-2030) after SNDS-II, with training of statistical system staff on the SNDS-II evaluation and system diagnostic questionnaires in preparation for data collection.
title: SNDS 2027-2030 : l'INSTAT GABON renforce les capacités des acteurs du Système Statistique National
